description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for specifying search filter parameters related to skills within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and provides properties for 'name' and 'description', with corresponding getters and setters. It also includes a constant for allowed sort fields and defaults the sort field to 's.name'.

classes.name: SkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating skill search filters, including 'name' and 'description', with allowed sort fields and default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'description' filter parameter.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'description' filter parameter.
